parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape and stability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components like doors, shelves, and base.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and the stored items, ensuring stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden panel similar to the left door, attached with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right side of the cabinet’s interior.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is a horizontal plywood panel inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet interior into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is another horizontal plywood panel inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and helps distribute weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
